meta_description:
439K likes, 821 comments - beerbiceps on October 5, 2026: "Happy birthday to literally the purest human being I've ever met 🪽❤️

I read many posts that said "How did Ranveer Allahbadia pull her???" 

And to all those posts - I don't know either! 

How can one person be this smart, this kind & this hardworking all at once? Not to mention, gorgeous. 

But jokes apart, I will one day reveal the crazy story of how we met. For now, all I wish to tell the world is this : Juhi found me when I was at my lowest. Her presence has made me value living again. Her presence has given me balance, ambition, peace AND SO MUCH MORE. 

Almost makes me feel like karma was cleaned up from my life so that I become worthy of receiving this beautiful relationship.

Damn I hate when people write long captions for their loved ones on their birthdays... But I guess you can't beat the power of love 🥰 

HBD Juhi ji. Thanks for everything ❤️❤️".
